## This holiday stretch can make (or break) your year.


~8 min read


Meredith PetersVP, Industry Relations


Black Friday. Cyber Monday. Giving Tuesday. The holidays drive[nearly a fifth of the year’s retail sales](https://nrf.com/research-insights/holiday-data-and-trends/winter-holidays/winter-holiday-faqs) , and your fans already want to score a deal from (and donate alongside) you. Here’s how I’d prep.


### Start Here


As soon as the final Thanksgiving turkey has been carved, your fans have shifted their focus—and they’re ready to spend on Black Friday. How can you stand out among big brands (with even bigger ad budgets)?


Answer: A direct message from a name they chose to hear from, delivered where no ad can reach. With the right text campaign, you’ll sell out tickets, drop your latest merch, or close out the stretch with an ask to give.


### Early November: Set Up Before You Send


1. **Connect Shopify.**[Connect your Shopify account](https://help.laylo.com/Shopify-Integration-1c023cdfc615837eb896812f7e4365f2) today so that links don’t come up empty on gameday.
2. **Turn on Abandoned Cart Agent** It texts fans who left something in their cart, so you don’t have to. It’s included on every paid plan. Turn it on by November 30, and[we’ll cover up to $1,000 of its fees](https://laylo.com/lp/bfcm) .
3. **Draft Your Black Friday Drop**[Build the page](https://help.laylo.com/Creating-a-Drop-ed523cdfc615823699e101a7f62c0285) , write the message, and schedule your go-live time. When November 27 rolls around, the only thing left to do is press send.


### November 27: The Black Friday Drop


When your fans wake up on November 27, every brand they follow will be screaming for their attention. Their inbox is full of promotions by 9 a.m.


Wanna get ahead of the chaos? Encourage fans to sign up for your Black Friday drop one week early, and your message goes to a list that’s already waiting for it.


1. **Announce on Tuesday, November 24.** Promote the drop wherever the most eyeballs will see it: social, your existing SMS and email list,[Instagram DMs and comments](https://help.laylo.com/Instagram-Integration-DMs-Comments-26223cdfc615831fb18e0157daaa8de9) , or fan clubs.
2. **Explain to fans what an RSVP gets them.** Once they sign up, they’re ready for updates all weekend. Exclusive merch, discounts, ticket offers—whatever it is for you, that’s the draw.
3. **Add an Upsell to the drop.**[Upsells](https://help.laylo.com/Upsells-Collabs-19623cdfc61583aab2b0012f7afa4b31) are follow-up links shown right after a fan RSVPs. In Laylo, you’ll find them in the Advanced tab (under “Follow-Up Actions”). Point one at a bundle, a higher tier or a VIP package.
4. **Three sentences, straight to the store.** Your drop-day message should leave little to the imagination: what it is, how they find it, and how much time they have left. The only thing left is to link directly to the product or collection page. Before it goes live, click “Send Test” in Laylo to text yourself the RSVP link.

### November 30: Cyber Monday’s Second-Chance Nudge


No need to start from scratch—your Black Friday RSVPs are still on the list (though they might need a nudge). One follow-up message turns carts into checkouts.


1. **Text the RSVPs who abandoned their carts.** With[Shopify connected](https://help.laylo.com/Shopify-Integration-1c023cdfc615837eb896812f7e4365f2) in Laylo, you can see which fans converted to customers over the weekend—and send the last call to everyone else. A reminder that the window closes tonight does more than a new offer. **Draft Monday’s last-call text now, while the Black Friday copy is still in front of you.**
2. **Make Monday stand out.** A restock, a new color, or free shipping. Fans can tell when Monday is just Friday’s deal with a new subject line.
3. **Stay on top of replies.** Fans will text you about sizes, shipping, and discount codes. A same-day answer is often the difference between a cart and a sale.


The Elovaters x Levitate collab merch. Their Abandoned Cart Agent recovers 28% of abandoned carts.[Read the case study](https://laylo.com/case-studies/the-elovaters-ai-agents)


### When the dust settles, Abandoned Cart keeps working for you


Fans who reached checkout (but didn’t follow through) haven’t changed their minds. They simply got a text, they were late for the train, or their kid woke up…and left their cart behind. After Cyber Monday ends, your Abandoned Cart Agent follows up for you, in your voice—making sure sales don’t disappear as the months go by.


1. **Toggle Abandoned Cart on before Black Friday (not during).** The Agent only works when set up ahead of time. Connect Shopify or MerchTable and turn it on by November 30, and[we’ll cover up to $1,000 of its fees through December 31](https://laylo.com/lp/bfcm) .
2. **Let it do the writing.** The Agent handles each nudge so you don’t have to.
3. **Keep it running through January.** Carts get abandoned well past the weekend. Check what it recovered after Cyber Monday, and see the[Abandoned Cart Agent guide](https://help.laylo.com/Abandoned-Cart-Agent-e7623cdfc615835596c601090a7edbce) for the full setup.


### On Giving Tuesday, run a fundraiser that’s true to you


Share your cause, explain why it matters to you, and make giving as easy as a Black Friday steal.


1. **Route fans to the cause with an Upsell.**[Upsell links](https://help.laylo.com/Upsells-Collabs-19623cdfc61583aab2b0012f7afa4b31) work with fundraising campaigns the same way they do merch pages. Add the donation link as the follow-up action on your Giving Tuesday drop.
2. **Turn merch into giving.** A signed item or a unique experience can drive proceeds towards your cause—while giving fans something they’ll cherish. One example: Shambhala Music Festival is auctioning limited SMF 2027 tickets on Laylo this Giving Tuesday, with 100% of the proceeds going to local charities.
3. **Send one text (and make it personal).** On the morning of December 1, fans only need to know three things: What the cause is, why it’s yours, and where they can give. A QR code on screen does the same job at a show that week. One text. That’s it. **Write one line now on why your cause matters to you, and save it as a draft in Laylo.**

### Once December hits, say thanks (and keep fans warm)


While orders begin shipping, most artists go dark. Your fans who recently engaged are as warm as they come—and a thank-you text goes a lot further than you think.


1. **Thank buyers and givers, separately.** Message your Black Friday buyers and your Giving Tuesday RSVPs within a few days.
2. **Read what comes back.** Fans reply with rough photos of your merch and notes about your cause. It’s the most honest feedback you’ll get all year.
3. **Set the stage for your first January drop.** One line about a show, a song, or a restock gives fans something to RSVP for. One message a week through December is plenty.


### Here’s Your Complete Send Calendar


Everything is set up before Thanksgiving. Everything that comes next is clicking send.


- Before Thanksgiving
- By Nov 16


Connect Shopify and turn on the Abandoned Cart Agent. It has to be on before Black Friday, and by Nov 30 for the fee offer.


- By Nov 20


Build your Black Friday drop in draft and set the go-live time. Write your Giving Tuesday message.


- Nov 16–20


Send one heads-up text: what’s coming and how to get first access.


- Black Friday week
- Tue, Nov 24


Announce the drop on SMS, email, social, DMs and fan clubs. Add the Upsell link under Follow-Up Actions.


- Fri, Nov 27


Drop goes live. Text your RSVPs first, then your full list.


- Nov 28–29


Answer fan replies the same day.


- Mon, Nov 30


Send the last-call text to RSVPs who haven’t bought.


- Tue, Dec 1


Send your Giving Tuesday text with the donation link. Put up a QR code at any show.


- After
- Week of Dec 7


Send thank-you texts to buyers and givers.


- Through January


Keep the Abandoned Cart Agent on.


- January


Create your first January drop.
